markers.name: PHASE_1_ARRIVAL_START
markers.note: cautious hope; recognition without scare

markers.name: BLOCK_P1_OINO_ENTERS
markers.note: Hesitant weight; eyeline finds father mid-melody before she sits; warm light already on the table.

markers.name: BLOCK_P1_FATHER_MID_MELODY
markers.note: Hands already in the phrase; she arrives late to a life that was going on without her.

markers.name: BLOCK_P1_FAMILIAR_MISTAKE
markers.note: Familiar musical mistake — pleasure of recognition, not failure. Links TABLE_FATHER_MUSICAL_MISTAKE.

markers.name: PHASE_1_ARRIVAL_END
markers.note: End ARRIVAL

markers.name: PHASE_2_PLEASURE_START
markers.note: warm, pleasurable, funny, safe — why she stays

markers.name: BLOCK_P2_FATHER_LAUGHS
markers.note: Small laugh; chest and shoulders live; timing must feel unplanned.

markers.name: BLOCK_P2_OINO_SITS
markers.note: She takes her chair; body softens into safety; eyeline enjoys him.

markers.name: BLOCK_P2_PREFERENCE_DISAGREEMENT
markers.action: has a preference, distraction, or small disagreement
markers.note: Disagreement about a note — tender and specific; two hearings, still safe.

markers.name: BLOCK_P2_ORDINARY_COMPANY
markers.action: she enjoys his ordinary company; his attention can leave her
markers.note: Glance toward the window; habit; ordinary pause — he is tender and specific, not a wish fulfilment puppet.

markers.name: PHASE_2_PLEASURE_END
markers.note: End PLEASURE

markers.name: PHASE_3_FIRST_RESET_START
markers.note: merciful control; second pass a fraction too precise

markers.name: BLOCK_P3_FATHER_BEGINS_LEAVE
markers.note: Rise toward window or doorway; his life continues past her need. Links TABLE_FATHER_EXIT_BEGIN.

markers.name: BLOCK_P3_FINDS_CONTROL
markers.note: Hand finds PROP_PlaybackControl; she tries to conceal the reset — soft face, shielding body. Camera: CAM_TABLE_OINO_CONTROL.

markers.name: BLOCK_P3_RESET_MERCY
markers.action: resets the scene; it feels merciful
markers.note: No alarm. No red warning. The gesture reads as keeping love a moment longer — still almost kindness.

markers.name: BLOCK_P3_SECOND_TOO_PRECISE
markers.action: second version plays a fraction too precise
markers.note: Same warmth on the surface; timings slightly quantized; laugh arrives early-or-late by a hair that the ear notices as wrong-life.

markers.name: PHASE_3_FIRST_RESET_END
markers.note: End THE FIRST RESET

markers.name: PHASE_4_LOSS_OF_SPONTANEITY_START
markers.note: dread from repetition and missing life

markers.name: BLOCK_P4_REMOVE_PAUSES
markers.note: Ordinary pause deleted; silence no longer comfortable — it is absent.

markers.name: BLOCK_P4_REMOVE_DISAGREEMENTS
markers.note: Note disagreement gone; preference flattened; he agrees on cue.

markers.name: BLOCK_P4_REMOVE_GLANCES
markers.note: No window glance; eyeline locked; independent attention dead.

markers.name: BLOCK_P4_REMOVE_DEPARTURES
markers.note: He never begins to leave; loop seals the table.

markers.name: BLOCK_P4_LAUGH_SAME_FRAME
markers.action: laughter occurs on exactly the same frame
markers.note: Identical laugh frame each loop — dread without scare sting. Compare to living laugh at f120.

markers.name: BLOCK_P4_ATTENTION_NO_INDEPENDENCE
markers.action: his attention no longer moves independently
markers.note: Eyes track Oino only; window unused; life-beyond-desire erased.

markers.name: BLOCK_P4_RECOGNITION_OWN_HAND
markers.action: recognizes that her own hand is creating the loss
markers.note: Eyeline drops to her hand on the control; no monster face — she sees authorship of the missing life.

markers.name: PHASE_4_LOSS_OF_SPONTANEITY_END
markers.note: End THE LOSS OF SPONTANEITY
